caption: The drawing shows a single metallic pitcher centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background which is bordered by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular line. The pitcher has a broad, bulbous lower body that narrows at the neck and then flares slightly at the top to form a spout with a pointed edge. Attached to the upper section is a curved handle that extends above and behind the pitcher, with a knobbed detail at its top attachment. The surface of the pitcher is rendered in shades of gray, blue, and black, giving it a reflective, polished appearance with visible highlights and facets suggesting metal. There are no additional objects, patterns, or decorations in the composition, and the background remains empty apart from some faint discoloration and the border.
title: Pewter Pitcher
